sections.content: SELECT retrieves data: SELECT columns FROM table. Use * for all columns, DISTINCT to remove duplicates, and AS to rename output columns.
SELECT name, age FROM users returns only those two columns for every row. Add WHERE to filter rows.
Key points: column order in SELECT defines output order, table aliases (u.name) clarify queries, and quoting rules differ per engine.
